name: VTuber Connect
source:
VTubers have taken the world by storm!

Among the many rising virtual streamers is Mana, who has captured the hearts of many with her unending positivity and creative talents. Shouma Hasegawa, discontent with the experiences he’s had with forming relationships during his first semester of college, is no exception to Mana’s charms as he has turned to VTubers as a place of refuge and comfort.

At the request of his older sister to pursue the value of in person relationships, Shouma steps back outside, where he meets a weary but playful girl with a peculiar bitterness towards the world. Captivated by the unrestrained disposition and thoughts of this girl, Shouma continues to interact with her, learning more about VTubers, himself, and the connection he seeks.

[From [url=https://verumvincula.itch.io/vtuber-connect]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
VTuber席卷了世界！

在众多冉冉升起的虚拟主播中，Mana以其无尽的积极性和创意才华俘获了许多人的心。长谷川翔马对大学第一学期建立人际关系的经历感到不满，他也不例外，因为Mana的魅力让他转向VTuber作为避难所和安慰。

应姐姐的要求追求人际关系的价值，寿马退到外面，在那里他遇到了一个疲惫但顽皮的女孩，她对世界有一种特殊的苦涩。小马被这个女孩奔放的性格和思想所吸引，继续与她互动，更多地了解VTuber、他自己以及他所寻求的联系。

[来自[url=https://verumvincula.itch.io/vtuber-connect]itch.io[/url]]
